parameters.name: CredentialConfig
parameters.description: The credential injection configuration for the instance. After this feature is enabled, you can use the default RAM role chain or specify a custom RAM role.

parameters.name: Cu
parameters.description: The number of CUs used by the instance.

parameters.name: Datasets
parameters.description: The list of datasets mounted to the instance.

sub_parameters.name: ExtOptions
sub_parameters.description: The custom mount properties of the dataset. The content is passed as mount options.

sub_parameters.name: MountPath
sub_parameters.description: The mount path of the dataset in the instance.

sub_parameters.name: ReadOnly
sub_parameters.description: Specifies whether to mount the dataset in read-only mode.

sub_parameters.name: Uri
sub_parameters.description: The storage service directory URI for direct mounting.

parameters.name: ImageId
parameters.description: The image ID. You can call ListServerIdeImages to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: ImageUrl
parameters.description: The image URL. This parameter is required when you use a non-DataWorks official image.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The personal development environment instance ID. You can call ListServerIdeInstances to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: InstanceName
parameters.description: The name of the personal development environment instance.

parameters.name: UserVpc
parameters.description: The VPC configuration used by the instance.
